run.trigger: Driver said they cannot reach the Leipzig pickup in time

steps.summary: Ferrari 296 GTB for Merovik Premiumfahrzeuge, Leipzig → Cologne. Driver Freya Marvellen (assigned).
4 recent messages. Latest from Driver marketplace: “Keep the accepted assignment on CD-420399 while we check replacement capacity. Please prepare a buyer update that says collection timing is…”
1 open alert (Assigned driver reports they cannot reach the selected Leipzig pickup after their current duty. Human review needed.), no incidents, 1 open task.
no bookings; no quote or capacity checks (not bookings).

input.text: Driver Freya Marvellen says they are still on another job toward Hamburg, need rest after it, and can travel no earlier than 22 Oct 13:00 (12:00 their time). That is after the Leipzig pickup slot.
Selected Leipzig pickup slot is 22 Oct 12:00–13:00 (11:00–12:00 Leipzig time). Delivery promise to the customer in Cologne is 23 Oct 14:00–16:00 (13:00–15:00 Cologne time).
No travel is booked or quoted for the driver to reach Leipzig, and there is no tracking on record for this order.
Pickup contact Lena Alderfield is unconfirmed and site access still needs checking (reception first, staff escort to side yard). No changed slot has been agreed with the customer.

If no replacement is found, a later collection on 22 Oct (driver arriving from Hamburg roughly mid-to-late afternoon) could still meet the 23 Oct delivery promise, since Leipzig–Cologne is about a 5-hour drive. This is a rough calculation and needs customer approval for the new slot.
